items.name: glass-provider
items.title: Glass Provider
items.description: Follows the device's appearance and accessibility settings and lets your app override them.

items.name: glass-surface
items.title: Glass Surface
items.description: The glass material on its own, with the backdrop Android blurs: the system’s own glass on iOS 26 and later, a lit blur elsewhere.

items.name: glass-button
items.title: Glass Button
items.description: A glass button that sets down under a press and lights up from the point you press.

items.name: glass-panel
items.title: Glass Panel
items.description: Glass cards, panels and pills for anything that floats above your content.

items.name: glass-input
items.title: Glass Input
items.description: A recessed glass text field with a label and an optional hint.

items.name: glass-textarea
items.title: Glass Textarea
items.description: A recessed glass field for longer text that can grow as you type.

items.name: glass-checkbox
items.title: Glass Checkbox
items.description: A glass checkbox whose mark draws itself in, with an indeterminate state.

items.name: glass-radio-group
items.title: Glass Radio Group
items.description: Options where exactly one is chosen, with a dot that pops in.

items.name: glass-switch
items.title: Glass Switch
items.description: An on/off switch whose knob turns to glass under a finger as it slides.

items.name: glass-slider
items.title: Glass Slider
items.description: A slider whose knob turns to glass while you drag it, for one value or a range.

items.name: glass-segmented-control
items.title: Glass Segmented Control
items.description: A single-choice control whose glass bubble springs between options.

items.name: glass-tabs
items.title: Glass Tabs
items.description: Tabs whose glass bubble springs to the selected tab.

items.name: glass-badge
items.title: Glass Badge
items.description: A small tinted label for status, counts and categories.

items.name: glass-progress
items.title: Glass Progress
items.description: A glass track with a fill that slides to its value, or sweeps when the length is unknown.

items.name: glass-spinner
items.title: Glass Spinner
items.description: A ring with a fading tail, for waiting on something short.

items.name: glass-skeleton
items.title: Glass Skeleton
items.description: A quiet placeholder with a slow sheen, shaped like what will replace it.

items.name: glass-alert
items.title: Glass Alert
items.description: A short message set in tinted glass, with four tones and an optional dismiss.

items.name: glass-avatar
items.title: Glass Avatar
items.description: A round photo that falls back to coloured initials, with a presence dot and stacked groups.

items.name: glass-accordion
items.title: Glass Accordion
items.description: Sections that expand and collapse on glass, one at a time or several.

items.name: glass-dock
items.title: Glass Dock
items.description: A row of icons on a glass shelf for an app's main destinations.

items.name: glass-dialog
items.title: Glass Dialog
items.description: A modal on raised glass that rises into place and holds focus until it closes.

items.name: glass-sheet
items.title: Glass Sheet
items.description: A glass panel that slides in from an edge. Bottom sheets drag down to dismiss.

items.name: glass-toast
items.title: Glass Toast
items.description: A glass notification for brief updates, announced to screen readers.

items.name: glass-menu
items.title: Glass Menu
items.description: A menu on glass that grows from its trigger, with checkbox and radio items.

items.name: glass-select
items.title: Glass Select
items.description: A glass trigger that opens a slab of glass to choose from.

items.name: glass-popover
items.title: Glass Popover
items.description: Floating glass content anchored to the control that opens it.

items.name: glass-picker
items.title: Glass Picker
items.description: A labelled glass picker: a native menu or wheel on iOS, a dropdown on Android and a select on the web.

items.name: glass-swipe-row
items.title: Glass Swipe Row
items.description: A row that reveals action buttons on swipe, for iOS, Android and the web.

items.name: glass-card-stack
items.title: Glass Card Stack
items.description: A swipeable card deck with Previous and Next buttons, for iOS, Android and the web.
